thought.text: The .env file has no newline! Fix:

reasoning_content: There's no newline between ARE_MODE and SUPABASE_AUTH! Let me fix that.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Fix .env with newlines  
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("echo 'ARE_MODE=shader\nPERSISTENCE_DRIVER=auto\nSUPABASE_AUTH=true\nSUPABASE_URL=http://localhost:8443\nSUPABASE_ANON_KEY=test\nNODE_ENV=production' > /opt/areloria/.env")
print("Fixed .env")

# Run
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && timeout 12 node server/dist/index.js 2>&1")
print("\n=== Run ===")
print(stdout.read().decode()[:600])

client.close()
EOF
